description: Full record for one organization by slug (as this server's results give it): every incident with its tier, dates, figures, data exposed, summary and the source records behind it. A California source record can carry `noticeLetter`, a passage quoted from its notice letter, with a credit line. A slug can be retired, for example when its organization is merged into another, or replaced after a rollback; a retired slug returns the current organization, with redirectedFrom naming the slug asked for. A slug that named a person who is not the organization (for example, an officer named in the filer's name) is withdrawn, not retired: it is not found (the API answers 404, with no redirect), and its organization goes on under another slug. Records are verified from regulator filings and Have I Been Pwned; a threat actor's claim is never a source. A miss means there is no record here, not that no breach happened. Counts from different sources are not additive.
